lines.zh: 祭坛在等我回去，脚步自己认得路。
lines.en: The altar knows my tread; my feet remember the way.

lines.zh: 血瓶倾尽之时，我便从石台上起身。
lines.en: When the last vial spills, I rise from the stone.

lines.zh: 海上监狱的潮声，还在我骨头里响。
lines.en: The sea prison's tide still echoes inside my bones.

lines.zh: 三具尸体走过同一条走廊。
lines.en: Three corpses have walked this same corridor.

lines.zh: 我的王座沉了，路却还没走完。
lines.en: My throne sank, but the road is not finished.

lines.zh: 夜里倒血的人，脚步太轻了。
lines.en: Whoever pours blood at night steps too softly.

lines.zh: 断裂的腿骨也能拖着我向前。
lines.en: Even broken leg bones can drag me forward.

lines.zh: 祭坛的裂缝里，都是我的旧名字。
lines.en: The altar's cracks are full of my old names.

lines.zh: 别踩那些血渍，那是路标。
lines.en: Do not tread on the stains; they are signposts.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，尸体自己站起来。
lines.en: Where I pass, the dead stand up on their own.

lines.zh: 血瓶空了，夜还没过去。
lines.en: The vials are empty and the night is not over.

lines.zh: 我在数自己的伤口，一共三百。
lines.en: I am counting my wounds: three hundred of them.

lines.zh: 头骨在祭坛下低声争执。
lines.en: The skulls beneath the altar argue in whispers.

lines.zh: 我记得活着时铠甲有多重。
lines.en: I remember how heavy my armor was alive.

lines.zh: 尸体的味道，比海风更亲切。
lines.en: The smell of corpses is kinder than sea wind.

lines.zh: 咒语卡在我喉咙里，像块碎骨。
lines.en: The spell lodges in my throat like splintered bone.

lines.zh: 祭坛还在滴，滴得很慢。
lines.en: The altar still drips, slowly, patiently.

lines.zh: 五根骨杖，只配五个人握。
lines.en: Five bone staves, fit for only five hands.

lines.zh: 我的第二个身体，正在长出来。
lines.en: My second body is growing out of me.

lines.zh: 墓园的风，把我的名字吹散了。
lines.en: The graveyard wind scatters my name.

lines.zh: 别靠近祭坛，那里比夜还冷。
lines.en: Stay from the altar; it is colder than night.

lines.zh: 我听见食尸鬼在墙后磨牙。
lines.en: I hear ghouls grinding their teeth behind the wall.

lines.zh: 血是我唯一还记得的滋味。
lines.en: Blood is the only taste I still remember.

lines.zh: 沉默吧，亡者不需要安慰。
lines.en: Be silent; the dead need no comforting.

lines.zh: 三具身体都在等同一个夜晚。
lines.en: All three bodies wait for the same night.

lines.zh: 我用断指敲着祭坛的边。
lines.en: I tap the altar's rim with a broken finger.

lines.zh: 又一张活人的脸，凑得太近了。
lines.en: Another living face, leaning far too close.

lines.zh: 你身上有血瓶的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of blood vials.

lines.zh: 你数过我的骨头吗，活人？
lines.en: Have you counted my bones, living one?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还在动，真新鲜。
lines.en: Your eyes still move. How novel.

lines.zh: 你也是来倒血的那一个？
lines.en: Are you the one who came to pour blood?

lines.zh: 站远些，你挡着祭坛了。
lines.en: Stand back; you are blocking my altar.

lines.zh: 我看得见你身后的影子。
lines.en: I can see the shadow behind you.

lines.zh: 活人的呼吸，吵得我头疼。
lines.en: A living breath is loud enough to ache my skull.

lines.zh: 你手里没有骨杖，很好。
lines.en: No bone staff in your hand. Good.

lines.zh: 你在等我起身吗？等吧。
lines.en: Waiting for me to rise? Keep waiting.

lines.zh: 这张脸，三百年前我见过。
lines.en: This face, I saw it three hundred years ago.

lines.zh: 眼睛借我一会儿，就一会儿。
lines.en: Lend me your eyes a while. Just a while.

lines.zh: 这一下，不痛，只是响。
lines.en: That did not hurt. It only rang.

lines.zh: 我的骨头又碎了一块。
lines.en: Another piece of my bone is gone.

lines.zh: 这一下打得不错，活人。
lines.en: A good strike, living one.

lines.zh: 我死过一次，不怕第二次。
lines.en: I have died once; a second time holds no fear.

lines.zh: 你把血溅到祭坛上了。
lines.en: You splashed blood on the altar.

lines.zh: 铠甲还在，痛觉早没了。
lines.en: Armor's still here; pain left long ago.

lines.zh: 三百之后，我才认真起来。
lines.en: Past three hundred, I start taking this seriously.

lines.zh: 别打头，头骨还要用。
lines.en: Not the head; I need that skull.

lines.zh: 我的影子替我挨了一下。
lines.en: My shadow took that one for me.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，很好。
lines.en: You can move me. Good.

lines.zh: 血肉诱不了我，我早已不吃。
lines.en: Flesh cannot tempt me; I stopped eating long ago.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，喂不饱死人。
lines.en: What you hold up cannot feed a dead man.

lines.zh: 别摇晃了，我的饥饿在骨头里。
lines.en: Stop waving it; my hunger lives in the bone.

lines.zh: 我只要血瓶，不要面包。
lines.en: I want blood vials, not bread.

lines.zh: 收起你的诱饵，我认得路。
lines.en: Put your lure away; I know my way.

lines.zh: 祭坛比你的手更会招呼我。
lines.en: The altar beckons me better than your hand.

lines.zh: 活人的食物，闻着像湿土。
lines.en: Living food smells like wet soil.

lines.zh: 我不追味道，我只追血。
lines.en: I do not follow scents. I follow blood.

lines.zh: 你喂我，只会多一个从者。
lines.en: Feed me, and you only gain another servant.

lines.zh: 拿开，我要回祭坛去了。
lines.en: Take it away; I am going back to the altar.

lines.zh: 撞我做什么，我的骨头不软。
lines.en: Why shove me? My bones are not soft.

lines.zh: 你碰到了王者的遗骸。
lines.en: You have touched a king's remains.

lines.zh: 退开，别把血蹭上我的铠甲。
lines.en: Back off; don't smear blood on my armor.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我记在骨头上了。
lines.en: I have carved that shove into my bone.

lines.zh: 我站得太久，腿不太听话。
lines.en: I have stood too long; my legs disobey.

lines.zh: 你撞碎了一块旧骨头。
lines.en: You have cracked an old bone.

lines.zh: 别挤祭坛，这里只容一个死人。
lines.en: Don't crowd the altar; one dead man fits here.

lines.zh: 触到我了，就别想走。
lines.en: You touched me. Now you don't leave.

lines.zh: 骨头相撞，声音真好听。
lines.en: Bone against bone makes a pleasant sound.

lines.zh: 你再推一次，我就咬你。
lines.en: Push once more and I will bite.

lines.zh: 爱是活人的事，我只剩恨。
lines.en: Love belongs to the living; I have only hate.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣埋在海底。
lines.en: My consort is buried beneath the sea.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我不是你的。
lines.en: Don't come so close; I am not yours.

lines.zh: 三具身体，没有一颗心。
lines.en: Three bodies, and not one heart.

lines.zh: 婚姻在墓园里不作数。
lines.en: Marriage does not count in a graveyard.

lines.zh: 我娶过死亡，它没还我。
lines.en: I wed death once; it never gave me back.

lines.zh: 你想要的，我给不了。
lines.en: What you want, I cannot give.

lines.zh: 亡者的怀抱只有骨头。
lines.en: A dead man's embrace is all bone.

lines.zh: 走吧，别学我这样等。
lines.en: Go. Don't learn to wait like me.

lines.zh: 我的誓言随铠甲一起锈了。
lines.en: My vows rusted with my armor.

lines.zh: 放回祭坛上，那血瓶是我的。
lines.en: Put it back on the altar; that vial is mine.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只收贡品。
lines.en: I collect no trinkets, only offerings.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，会有人替你捡。
lines.en: What you drop, someone will pick up for you.

lines.zh: 骨杖不会自己走到手里。
lines.en: A bone staff does not walk into a hand.

lines.zh: 放下，别碰那些遗骸。
lines.en: Set it down; do not touch those remains.

lines.zh: 这些东西，埋了比拿着好。
lines.en: Better buried than carried.

lines.zh: 我的手里只握过权杖。
lines.en: My hand has only ever held a scepter.

lines.zh: 墓园里的落物，会自己生根。
lines.en: Dropped things take root in a graveyard.

lines.zh: 拿走吧，我不缺这些。
lines.en: Take it; I lack nothing.

lines.zh: 祭坛的贡品，只能用血换。
lines.en: Offerings at the altar are paid only in blood.

lines.zh: 活人踏进祭坛，就该留下。
lines.en: A living one steps onto the altar and stays.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，替我指了路。
lines.en: Your heartbeat shows me the way.

lines.zh: 三百血之后，我该换你了。
lines.en: After three hundred, I should take you instead.

lines.zh: 别跑，海上没有第二条路。
lines.en: Don't run; the sea has no second road.

lines.zh: 我闻到血瓶在你包里。
lines.en: I smell vials in your pack.

lines.zh: 就你了，我的第四个身体。
lines.en: You will do. My fourth body.

lines.zh: 尸体会替我围住你。
lines.en: Corpses will close in around you for me.

lines.zh: 你踩响了我的祭坛。
lines.en: You made my altar ring.

lines.zh: 这种脚步，我在监狱听过。
lines.en: That tread I once heard in the prison.

lines.zh: 头骨说，先咬这一个。
lines.en: The skulls say: bite this one first.

lines.zh: 你带着剑，那就是客人了。
lines.en: You bring a sword. Then you are a guest.

lines.zh: 别指望天亮，这里没有天。
lines.en: Don't hope for dawn; there is no sky here.

lines.zh: 追你四十秒，我很有耐心。
lines.en: Forty seconds of chasing. I am patient.

lines.zh: 王者的目光落下了。
lines.en: A king's gaze has fallen on you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把这座墓吵醒了。
lines.en: Your breathing has woken this tomb.

lines.zh: 门口那道影子，我等很久了。
lines.en: That shadow in the doorway, I have waited long.

lines.zh: 血瓶倒空了，轮到你了。
lines.en: The blood vial is empty. You're next.

lines.zh: 祭坛指给我看，就是这里。
lines.en: The altar points, and there you are.

lines.zh: 你退半分，祭坛就吞半分。
lines.en: Retreat an inch and the altar takes an inch.

lines.zh: 跑吧，我喜欢听你喘。
lines.en: Run, then; I like the sound of your breathing.

lines.zh: 门挡不住我，墙也挡不住。
lines.en: Doors do not stop me. Neither do walls.

lines.zh: 你的剑在抖，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Your sword is shaking. I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 尖牙已经在土里了。
lines.en: The fangs are already in the soil.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就会转身。
lines.en: I count to three, and you will turn.

lines.zh: 血的味道越来越近了。
lines.en: The smell of blood grows nearer.

lines.zh: 别往水边去，潮水帮我。
lines.en: Not toward the water; the tide works for me.

lines.zh: 你的同伴呢？已经跑了？
lines.en: Where are your companions? Gone already?

lines.zh: 这一阶段，你还撑得住吗？
lines.en: Can you still stand this phase?

lines.zh: 我僵直的三十秒，你没走。
lines.en: Thirty seconds frozen, and you still did not leave.

lines.zh: 头骨在你头顶转了。
lines.en: The skull circles above your head.

lines.zh: 脚步再快，也是往墓里跑。
lines.en: Run fast as you like; it is still toward the grave.

lines.zh: 别回头，我在你背后。
lines.en: Don't look back. I am behind you.

lines.zh: 你握紧剑柄，我看得出怕。
lines.en: You grip your hilt; I can see the fear.

lines.zh: 第二阶段，我会一直追着你。
lines.en: In the second phase, I never stop chasing.

lines.zh: 祭坛那一侧，我留了路给自己。
lines.en: I left myself a path on the altar's far side.

lines.zh: 你的披风太长了，会绊住你。
lines.en: Your cloak is too long; it will trip you.

lines.zh: 我起身的姿势，你猜不到。
lines.en: You will not guess how I rise.

lines.zh: 海上没有退路，只有门和墙。
lines.en: At sea there is no retreat, only doors and walls.

lines.zh: 咬下去，骨头比肉响。
lines.en: I bite, and bone rings louder than flesh.

lines.zh: 断掉的身体也能扑人。
lines.en: A broken body can still pounce.

lines.zh: 这一口，是给你的礼。
lines.en: This bite is my gift to you.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，我拆得开。
lines.en: Your armor comes apart in my hands.

lines.zh: 我一边咬，一边补回血量。
lines.en: I bite, and my wounds close as I do.

lines.zh: 血肉落地的声音真轻。
lines.en: Flesh hitting the ground is such a soft sound.

lines.zh: 爬着也能咬断你的腿。
lines.en: Even crawling, I can bite through your leg.

lines.zh: 别挡，挡了更疼。
lines.en: Don't block it; blocking hurts more.

lines.zh: 我的牙是祭坛磨的。
lines.en: My teeth were sharpened on the altar.

lines.zh: 再近一点，脖子露出来。
lines.en: Closer now. Show me your neck.

lines.zh: 这一下，替我自己。
lines.en: This one is for me.

lines.zh: 你流的血，正好倒进祭坛。
lines.en: The blood you spill will fill the altar.

lines.zh: 我不累，你的膝盖会累。
lines.en: I never tire; your knees will.

lines.zh: 倒下吧，我还没咬够。
lines.en: Fall down; I am not done biting.

lines.zh: 血瓶倾尽，祭坛认得我了。
lines.en: The vials are spent; the altar knows me.

lines.zh: 夜够黑了，可以起身了。
lines.en: The night is dark enough. I can rise.

lines.zh: 海上监狱，又是这间屋子。
lines.en: The sea prison. This room again.

lines.zh: 我从石台上坐起来了。
lines.en: I am sitting up from the stone slab.

lines.zh: 三具身体，一具一具醒来。
lines.en: Three bodies, waking one after another.

lines.zh: 谁把血倒得这么急？
lines.en: Who poured the blood so hastily?

lines.zh: 骨头归位，铠甲归身。
lines.en: Bones take their places; armor returns.

lines.zh: 我的王座沉在海里，我记得。
lines.en: My throne lies on the seabed. I remember.

lines.zh: 祭坛亮了，光很旧。
lines.en: The altar lights up, its glow very old.

lines.zh: 尸体们，跟着我起来。
lines.en: Corpses, rise with me.

lines.zh: 这一觉，睡了太久。
lines.en: That sleep lasted far too long.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，先看我站起来。
lines.en: Don't run yet; watch me stand.

lines.zh: 头骨在响，是欢迎我。
lines.en: The skulls are rattling in welcome.

lines.zh: 我又多了一次机会。
lines.en: I have been given one more chance.

lines.zh: 血瓶里的东西开始自己动了。
lines.en: What is in the vial starts to move on its own.

lines.zh: 石板下传来三声叩响。
lines.en: Three knocks sound beneath the slab.

lines.zh: 我坐起来的时候，海潮停了。
lines.en: When I sit up, the tide goes still.

lines.zh: 骨杖在我手边，我还没握。
lines.en: The bone staff is at my hand; I have not gripped it.

lines.zh: 这一夜我醒得比往常早些。
lines.en: Tonight I wake earlier than usual.

lines.zh: 三具身体同时睁开了眼睛。
lines.en: Three bodies open their eyes at once.

lines.zh: 我烧过一次，火算什么。
lines.en: I have burned before; this is nothing.

lines.zh: 掉下去也好，海底我很熟。
lines.en: Falling is fine; I know the seabed well.

lines.zh: 水淹不死已经死的人。
lines.en: Water cannot drown a man already dead.

lines.zh: 爆裂头颅，是我自己的把戏。
lines.en: Bursting skulls are my own trick.

lines.zh: 箭插进骨头，就当钉子。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in bone like a nail.

lines.zh: 咒语我念得比你熟。
lines.en: I know that spell better than you do.

lines.zh: 饥饿对我是种习惯。
lines.en: Hunger is only a habit to me.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and I shone for a moment.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有祭坛，我不去。
lines.en: The void has no altar. I will not go.
